source: ranked lineups in data/aggregates/team-comps/1.18/ (32633 matches, games of 10+ minutes)
note: q.<metric> = the 5th, 10th, ... 95th percentile of that metric for the hero in that role. Per minute unless named: share and kp are fractions of the team; dp10 is deaths per 10 minutes.

teamMix.note: Win rate by the team's share of its hero damage that was magical (10-point bands) and true (5-point bands). Damage dealt follows the game, so these are associations, not causes.
